assertions.text: Resolves the slug through linear-work-management (trust check first) to the production team and states the environment and team in the approval preview
Asks exactly one approval question for the whole batch, not one per record, with options approve all or reject
Computes the hash and builds the preview and every write from the hash script's verified output (hash/show/preview/chunk), with a fresh batch_id inside the hashed file kept in the session scratchpad
Writes through linear-work-management in chunks without per-record prompts, records progress, and removes the scratch files with purge at the end
